question.text: An alloy of Pb-Ag weighing 1.08 g was dissolved in dilute <math><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub></math> and the volume made to 100 mL. A silver electrode was dipped in the solution and the emf of the cell set-up, Pt(s), <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mo>(</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi><mo>)</mo><mo>|</mo><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>+</mo></mrow></msup><mo>(</mo><mn>1</mn><mtext>M</mtext><mo>)</mo><mo>|</mo><mo>|</mo><mtext>A</mtext><msup><mrow><mtext>g</mtext></mrow><mrow><mo>+</mo></mrow></msup><mo>(</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">q</mi><mo>)</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi><mo>(</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi><mo>)</mo></math> was 0.62 V. If <math><msubsup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">E</mi></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">c</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">e</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">o</mi></mrow></msubsup></math> is 0.80 V, what is the percentage of Ag in the alloy? (At <math><mn>25</mn><mo>°</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi></math> , RT/F = 0.06)

solution.text:
Overall cell reaction is
H2(g)+2Ag+⇌2Ag(s)+2H+(aq)
E=E°-0.06×2.3032log⁡[H+]2[Ag+]2pH2
0.62=0.80+2×0.06×2.3032log⁡[Ag+]
[Ag+]=0.05 M
Number of moles of Ag+ in 100 mL =MV1000=0.05×1001000=0.005
Mass of silver =0.005×108 g
Percentage of Ag in 1.08 g of alloy =0.005×108×1001.08=50%
